title: Review of lab 1's autopoiesis/membrane_kinds (SIBD): first labkit packs of this world replicate on fresh seeds 3 and 4: walled cells from noise (L link ring membrane-like in 53/64 and 77/99 individuals), 7 and 15 persistent splits to generation 2-3; chi=0 removes the ring (3/189)
summary: Labkit packs of threads/autopoiesis/worlds/membrane_kinds/world.py (unchanged), 128^2, t=0-10000, seeds 3 and 4; and the same world with chi=0 on seed 3. From smoothed noise over the whole domain (sheet t=0), the field breaks into 8-22 discrete cells with a bright wall. Link L: aggregate rim/core 1.69 and 1.59, rim/out 4.8 and 4.1, membrane-like individually in 53/64 and 77/99 cells; the wall channel is also membrane-like. Division: 64-67 splits, 7 and 15 persistent, max generation 2 and 3, merge/split 0.09-0.11. chi=0: L rim/core 1.14, 3/189 cells membrane-like, while division continues (37 persistent splits), so the ring comes from the link adsorption and division does not need it. The catalyst kinds K1/K2 carry no ring (rim/core 0.9-1.1).

observations.B: pack/seed3/FACTS.md, pack/seed4/FACTS.md: L link membrane-like 53/64 and 77/99 individually; pack_chi0: 3/189
observations.D: pack/seed4/lineage.png: 15 persistent splits, generation 3; seed 3: 7, generation 2

seeds_run.result: pass: S I B D (7 persistent splits, gen 2)
pass: S I B D (15 persistent splits, gen 3)
chi=0 ablation: no ring, division continues

verdicts.limitation: These packs cover the base cells (SIBD) only; the kinds/mutation part (L6 heredity, the infection law) was not examined. The ring is links drifting up the wall indicator (chi term written against the body field); the links are made by the cells' catalyst, which RUBRIC L3's quasi-equilibrium clause allows, and the ring does no work for division here (chi=0 divides more). Generations are short (2-3) at labkit's 1000 t window.
